title: The Hobbit
author: J. R. R. Tolkien
description: Bilbo Baggins leaves his quiet hobbit hole for a dangerous quest with thirteen dwarves to win back a stolen treasure from a dragon.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: On the desert planet Arrakis, young Paul Atreides is drawn into a struggle over the most valuable resource in the universe.

author: George Orwell
description: In a world of constant surveillance, Winston Smith begins to question the Party that controls every part of life and truth.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: Elizabeth Bennet navigates family pressure, first impressions and misjudgements in a classic story of manners and love.

title: A Brief History of Time
author: Stephen Hawking
description: An accessible tour of black holes, the Big Bang and the nature of time for readers without a physics background.

title: Cosmos
author: Carl Sagan
description: A journey through the universe and the history of scientific discovery, written with wonder and clarity.

title: Sapiens
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: A sweeping history of humankind, from early hunter-gatherers to the modern age of technology.

title: Guns, Germs, and Steel
author: Jared Diamond
description: Explores why some societies grew powerful while others did not, looking at geography, agriculture and disease.

title: Charlotte's Web
author: E. B. White
description: A clever spider named Charlotte saves her friend Wilbur the pig in a gentle story about friendship.

title: Where the Wild Things Are
author: Maurice Sendak
description: Max sails to an island of wild creatures and becomes their king in this classic picture book.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A practical guide to building good habits and breaking bad ones through small, steady changes.

title: Deep Work
author: Cal Newport
description: Argues for the value of focused, distraction-free work and offers rules for training your attention.
